mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recurring_lesson_schedules (course_id, title, description, start_date, end_date, active) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{active})
INSERT INTO recurring_lesson_slots (schedule_id, day_of_week, start_time) VALUES (#{scheduleId}, #{dayOfWeek}, #{startTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, course_id, title, description, start_date, end_date, active FROM recurring_lesson_schedules WHERE id = #{scheduleId}
SELECT id, course_id, title, description, start_date, end_date, active FROM recurring_lesson_schedules WHERE course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY active DESC, id DESC
SELECT id FROM recurring_lesson_schedules WHERE active = 1 ORDER BY id
SELECT id, schedule_id, day_of_week, start_time FROM recurring_lesson_slots WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND active = 1 ORDER BY day_of_week, start_time
SELECT id, schedule_id, day_of_week, start_time FROM recurring_lesson_slots WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} ORDER BY day_of_week, start_time
mapper.update: UPDATE recurring_lesson_slots SET active = 0 WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId}
UPDATE recurring_lesson_slots SET active = 1 WHERE id = #{slotId}
UPDATE recurring_lesson_schedules SET active = #{active} WHERE id = #{scheduleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recurring_lesson_occurrences (slot_id, scheduled_at) VALUES (#{slotId}, #{scheduledAt}) ON CONFLICT (slot_id, scheduled_at) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE recurring_lesson_occurrences SET lesson_id = #{lessonId} WHERE slot_id = #{slotId} AND scheduled_at = #{scheduledAt}
UPDATE lessons SET outcome = 'CANCELLED' WHERE recurring_schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND scheduled_at > #{now} AND outcome = 'AUTO'
